mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, stock, category FROM products ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, description, price, stock, category FROM products WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, stock, category) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, category = #{category} WHERE id = #{id}
